title: fix: replace broken Flux fallback with Replicate
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Keeps Vast/Nunchaku as the primary FLUX.1 Schnell route and replaces only the broken Fireworks burst fallback with `black-forest-labs/flux-schnell` on Replicate.
- Fireworks reported the model as ready, but every fallback request returned 404 and the model had no deployed references; a live Replicate probe succeeded in 0.49s.
- Keeps the public price unchanged at `$0.002/image`, `priceMultiplier: 1`, and `paidOnly: false`; Replicate costs `$0.003` per fallback image.
- Uses the existing `REPLICATE_API_TOKEN`; no secret or registry-provider changes.

Validation:
- `npx vitest run test/image/fluxFallback.test.ts` — 3 passed
- Focused generation Worker tests — 2 passed

gist.headline: Flux found a spare wing
gist.blurb: The FLUX.1 Schnell fallback was pointing at a door Fireworks said existed, but did not. It now lands on Replicate when the primary Vast/Nunchaku route needs backup, with the public price staying at $0.002 per image.
gist.summary: Replaced the broken Fireworks burst fallback for FLUX.1 Schnell with Replicate's black-forest-labs/flux-schnell model while keeping Vast/Nunchaku primary and the public $0.002/image price unchanged.
gist.impact: FLUX.1 Schnell image requests now have a working Replicate backup route when the primary path is unavailable, instead of reaching Fireworks 404 responses.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden workshop where Polli repairs a broken fallback pipe between a primary Vast/Nunchaku image machine and a reliable Replicate flower-powered backup generator. Use a small route sign showing "FLUX" and a healthy green alternate path; include code-plants and a subtle crossed-out 404 page as the old broken route.
